messages:
harper: Morning! Quick thing 1: someone left a half-open sushi tray in the fridge overnight. If it's yours please claim or I'll toss at lunch (sorry). Also mug etiquette reminder: please tag mugs with initials or they disappear into the dev lair.
mike: Not mine. I think that sushi is from the 2pm client lunch yesterday. Toss away if unclaimed. Re: mugs, can we get a cheap label maker? Tiny sticky notes keep falling off.
tess: I have a label maker we can borrow 1 I'll set it on the counter at 10:30. Also proposing a "mug shelf" labeled with letters A-F so people can leave mugs visible.
oliver: Love the mug shelf. Also FYI the single-serve soy milk is nearly empty 1 can someone add it to the shopping list?
zara: Adding to shopping list now: soy milk, black tea bags, nut-free snack bars, replacement sugar packets. Also vote: sushi for Friday team lunch or order from local deli?
harper: Poll: "Friday team lunch preference" options: Sushi, Deli. Vote ends 1979991600.
mike: Deli (allergy-safe options).
tess: Sushi if we get allergen-labeled trays, otherwise Deli.
oliver: Deli works. Also small PSA: please don't store raw fish in the shared mini fridge on the top shelf 1 temp fluctuates.
kitchen-bot: Shopping item added: soy milk, black tea, nut-free bars. Poll created: "Friday team lunch preference" ends 1979991600. Reminder scheduled: "Label maker return" at 1979994500.
zara: Thanks kitchen-bot! I'll place a Post-it on the fridge: "No raw proteins top shelf".
harper: If anyone borrows a mug, please add your name on the shelf tag. First offender will be subjected to playful mug shaming. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
mike: I accept the risk. Also who borrowed the extra coffee filters? I couldn't find the box.
tess: I used a few last week 1 left the empty box on the recycling shelf by mistake. I'll replenish.
zara: Final note: if you bring pastries please put them on the pastry plate with a cover (we lost an entire croissant to mystery crumbs last week).
harper: Great. Mug shelf plan + shopping list + poll in motion. See you at snack o'clock. :coffee:
